app.name: Super Spine Viewer
app.tagline: Load and export Spine animations in the browser, with transparent video

dropzone.title: Drop Spine assets here
dropzone.hint: Needs a .skel / .json skeleton, an .atlas file and its texture PNGs; a whole folder is fine

preview.empty: No skeleton loaded yet — drop some files first

errors.missingTextures: Texture pages referenced by the atlas are missing: {{names}}
errors.unknownVersion: Could not detect the Spine version of the skeleton file
errors.runtime2d: Assets exported from Spine 2.x are not supported — the 2D runtime is not wired up
errors.runtimeFuture: Assets from newer Spine versions are not supported yet (closest available runtime: {{version}})
errors.allCandidatesFailed: Every candidate runtime failed to parse this skeleton: {{detail}}
errors.binaryUnsupported: The current runtime cannot parse .skel for Spine {{version}} (usually a manually selected runtime mismatch); switch back to auto-detect

warnings.skeletonFallback: {{from}} could not be parsed, falling back to {{to}}
warnings.runtimeFallback: Rendered with the Spine {{to}} runtime ({{pack}}) instead of {{from}}
warnings.manualRuntime: Loaded with the manually selected runtime {{pack}}

export.alphaHint: MP4 containers cannot carry an alpha channel — pick VP9 WebM or APNG for transparency
